# .pzfx import fixtures

- `*.pzfx` except `synthetic_*.pzfx`: example files generated by GraphPad Prism, copied from the
  CRAN package [pzfx](https://github.com/Yue-Jiang/pzfx) 0.3.1 (`inst/extdata`, `inst/testdata`)
  by Yue Jiang (author and maintainer) with contributions from David Micklem. MIT license,
  copyright 2018 Yue Jiang.
- `synthetic_*.pzfx`: hand-written for these tests (not from Prism): several tables, exclusions,
  summary formats, notes, a skipped table kind, and a text cell.
- `*.expected.json`: what `pzfx::read_pzfx` reads from each file (values with excluded cells kept,
  plus the exclusion mask), regenerated with `cd tools/oracle && Rscript pzfx_fixtures.R`.
